Kingdom Content Challenge · Innovation Engine

Nexus Pitches & Storytellers

Empowering visionary digital creators, cinematic storytellers, and Kingdom tech builders to pitch directly to global funders, media executives, and distributors.

14–16 April 2027 · Royal Majestic Hotel, Rosebank, Johannesburg
Challenge Tracks

Eligible Digital & Media Formats

01

YouTube & Streaming Channels

High-growth video platforms producing compelling biblical lifestyle, teaching, culture, or youth-focused digital media.

02

Podcast & Audio Narratives

Innovative narrative journalism, episodic drama, and discourse podcasts shaping continental and diaspora thought.

03

Faith-Based Series & Films

Feature screenplays, documentary treatments, and limited episodic series carrying redemptive narrative power.

04

Kingdom Apps & AI Platforms

Digital tools, discipleship platforms, interactive software, and AI solutions driving church growth and community impact.

Adjudication Process

Pitching to Decision Makers

Shortlisted creators will pitch live at Faith Nexus 2027 in Johannesburg before a curated panel comprising:

  • ✦ Global Broadcast & Streaming Executives
  • ✦ Kingdom Philanthropists & Angel Investors
  • ✦ Technology Strategists & Venture Incubators
  • ✦ Apostolic & Institutional Leaders
Prizes & Catalytic Support

Acceleration Package

Winning projects receive direct production financing, distribution syndication, and incubation:

  • ✦ Direct Seed Funding & Development Grants
  • ✦ Broadcast & Digital Distribution Agreements
  • ✦ 6-Month Executive Mentorship & Advisory
  • ✦ Special Recognition feature in CW100
